---
title: "Racial Demographics of Sarasota County"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Load data previously downloaded to data/
race_data <- read_rds("data/sarasota_race.rds")

# Calculate percentage of minority residents by tract
race_wide <- race_data |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(pct_minority = 100 * (1 - White / Total))

# Get tract geometries for Sarasota County
sarasota_tracts <- tracts(state = "FL", county = "Sarasota", year = 2020, cb = TRUE)

# Join boundaries with the downloaded race data
sarasota_map <- left_join(sarasota_tracts, race_wide, by = "GEOID")

# Plot choropleth map
ggplot(sarasota_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_minority), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "% Minority",
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Racial Demographics in Sarasota County, Florida",
    subtitle = "Percentage of non-White residents by census tract",
    caption = "Source: 2020 Decennial Census via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

The choropleth above displays the distribution of minority residents across census tracts in Sarasota County from the 2020 Decennial Census, showing higher concentrations of diversity around urban centers compared to coastal and suburban tracts.
